references.text: The preceding text addresses the same topic of rape of a betrothed woman, but in a city where she could have cried out for help.
The continuation explains that the woman should not be punished because she was in the field and no one could hear her cry for help.
A similar case concerning the rape of an unbetrothed virgin and the consequences for the perpetrator.
Shechem took Dinah by force and lay with her, an example of sexual violence in the Bible.
Amnon raped his half-sister Tamar by using physical force, paralleling the description 'held fast to her'.
Law regarding the seduction of an unbetrothed virgin, which provides background for laws on sexual immorality.
